text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein receives congratulations on army day.
- Iraq welcomes United Arab Emirates calls for Arab reconciliation.
- UAE president calls for the lifting of sanctions on Iraq.
- Saddam delivers speech on army day.
- Housing and reconstruction minister opens new bridge.
- Iraq to take part in an Arab information meeting in Cairo.
(The above were also carried by AL-JUMHOURIYA and AL-IRAQ)
